# Second Critique — Thirty Final Invariants

The Awtsmoos needs no parser to know; our engine should not pretend it can;
Awtsmoos.com becomes a faithful machine vessel, while intelligence remains with the calling agent's plan.

1. No prompt field in runtime API.
2. No subject-to-feature inference.
3. No lowercase/regex semantic scans.
4. No camera keyword scan.
5. No mode inference from prose.
6. No duration inference from prose.
7. No provider callback in runtime state.
8. No provider global in installers.
9. No provider revision fallback.
10. No prompt compiler public export.
11. No natural-language revision field.
12. Canonical movie object accepted directly.
13. Canonical JSON accepted only as serialization of that object.
14. Invalid JSON leaves state unchanged.
15. Invalid movie leaves state unchanged.
16. Validation details remain machine-addressable.
17. Patch operations are explicit structured objects.
18. Invalid patch leaves movie unchanged.
19. Undo/redo remain deterministic.
20. Projection remains renderer-specific.
21. Literal text content is opaque to behavior.
22. Agent bridge supports `loadMovie`.
23. Agent bridge supports `applyPatches`.
24. Agent bridge supports `getMovie`.
25. Agent bridge supports capability/contract discovery.
26. CustomEvent ingestion is structured-only if retained.
27. Mobile data panel remains touch-friendly.
28. Existing 180-second movie remains valid.
29. Five participating apps still mount the same data runtime.
30. Static audit confirms no language interpretation code is reachable from public/runtime surfaces.
